reuse.why: Keeps getDateWithSkippedWeekend for non-daily schedules, but writes the daily skip as an inline loop in getNextDate rather than in a shared weekend definition that the other weekend paths could use.

duplication.why: No copy within the diff, but the frequency === 'daily' plus skipWeekend test is written twice (isDailySkippingWeekend and the guard around the move), and the rule is not shared with other paths.

placement.why: The rule is wired into the shared getNextDate, but getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts apply the weekend rule themselves through getDateWithSkippedWeekend and are not updated.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: The cursor-advancing loop is clear, but the guard re-tests frequency instead of reusing isDailySkippingWeekend, and daily schedules now behave differently depending on which path computes the date.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate: the daily skip is decided inline and getDateWithSkippedWeekend is bypassed for daily schedules, while other callers of the helper keep moving daily weekend dates

one_place.where: only getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts changes; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and both nextDate computations in budget/schedule-template.ts still move daily weekend occurrences through getDateWithSkippedWeekend
